chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hafiz al-Ju'abi told us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani told me, saying: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Khalaf told us, saying: Sahl ibn [Ismail ibn] 'Amir told us, saying: Zafir ibn Sulayman told us, from Shareek, from Abu Ishaq, saying: I said to Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both): What is the meaning of the saying of the Prophet (Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family): 'Whoever I am his Leader, then Ali is his Leader'?
He said: He informed them that he is the Imam after him.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Man kuntu mawlahu' according to Ali ibn al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Ali ibn al-Husayn (AS) provides a definitive exegesis of the Ghadir declaration, clarifying that 'Mawla' denotes authoritative leadership (*Imamah*) rather than mere affection. This interpretation anchors the event as the formal designation of Ali ibn Abi Talib as the immediate successor, a cornerstone of Shia theological consensus regarding the Prophet's explicit appointment (*Nass*).
